units.source_text: 长老照旧安宁地微笑，接着说：“那你就不知道了。

en.t: The elder smiled peacefully as usual, then went on, "Then you do not know.

units.source_text: 我们的神用一天的时间就创造了整个世界。

en.t: Our god created the entire world in a single day.

units.source_text: （“生命之树”尽管也是一棵树，但是它却没有什么不能做到的事情。）

en.t: Although the Tree of Life was also a tree, there was nothing it could not do.
and then created the female kappa.

units.source_text: 但是只有雌河童太孤独了，它需要个雄河童来做伴。

en.t: But the female kappa was far too lonely by herself, and she needed a male kappa for company.

units.source_text: 我们的神以慈悲为怀，取出雌河童的脑髓创造了雄河童。

en.t: Our god, moved by compassion, took out the female kappa's brain matter and created the male kappa.

units.source_text: 我们的神对这一对河童祝福着：‘吃吧，兴致勃勃地活下去。’”

en.t: Our god blessed this pair of kappa, saying, 'Eat, and live on with gusto.'"
